statement.essentials: At its exit from the skull the nerve is only about 2–3 mm thick.
statement.anatomy: The trunk measures about 2.7 mm across where it leaves the stylomastoid foramen.

numbers.label: Trunk diameter at the stylomastoid foramen

limitations: Fixed tissue; the diameter falls as the nerve divides, and branches are far thinner than the trunk. Branch calibres in the model are authored from published ranges.
